messages:
maria_cs: Kestrel submitted a bespoke SIG/CAIQ yesterday, due Friday EOD. They attached a request for: KMS/HSM attestation, sample audit logs for export flows, data retention mapping, and a short repro for a 401 they hit when exporting the SIG. They also called out a billing spike tied to export jobs — customer is asking for timeline + remediation plan. Can ENG + Security weigh in?

jordan_eng: thanks — can you paste the exact 401 payload they reported and any request IDs? we need a repro to rule out client misconfig. also which export API? 

maria_cs: pasted from their support ticket: 

KestrelOps (customer): "When we request a SIG export via POST /v1/exports/sig we intermittently get 401s. Example: curl -i -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports/sig\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -d '{"customer_id":"kestrel-01","format":"json"}'

Response:
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2024 14:12:05 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"unauthorized","request_id":"req_7a9f2c3d"}

They also attached our billing invoice showing a spike on 2024-05-31 (export batch job garbled).

maria_cs: customer wants evidence artifacts we can provide for SIG: 
- HSM attestation (latest cert / date)
- KMS key rotation dates and policy doc
- Audit log sample showing an export sequence (anonymized)
- Retention mapping for exported artifacts (how long and where they live)

ashley_sec: ok — security can provide: HSM attestation PDF (signed 2024-04-02), KMS rotation history CSV, and guidance on audit log format. I'll need the specific request_id(s) to pull the exact log entries (we can redact PII). jordan, can you capture req_7a9f2c3d in the log store? if not, give me the approximate timeframe.

jordan_eng: looking now — req_7a9f2c3d appears in edge logs around 2024-06-03T14:12:05Z. I see a 401 returned by auth-proxy due to a transient token validation timeout to KMS (504 on backend). snippet from edge: 

[2024-06-03T14:12:05Z] req=req_7a9f2c3d path=/v1/exports/sig status=401 upstream_status=504 upstr_host=kms-us-east-1 msg=\"token validation failed: upstream timeout\"

jordan_eng: repro steps I recommend to verify locally: 
1) Use the customer's token via curl (or issue a short-lived test token)
2) Run export POST 20x to surface any rate/burst issues
3) Watch our auth-proxy metrics for 5xxs to KMS during the run

maria_cs: customer is asking if we can extend the SIG due date to next Wednesday — can we commit to artifacts by then?

ashley_sec: extension sounds reasonable. I can assemble HSM attestation and rotation CSV by tomorrow EOD. For the audit log sample, I need the exact request_id(s) (we have req_7a9f2c3d). I'll pull the sequence and redact IPs. Retention mapping is standard doc we can attach. Recommend we give Kestrel: HSM attestation + rotation history + redacted audit trace + brief root-cause note explaining the transient KMS timeout and mitigation (retry/backoff + monitoring).

jordan_eng: +1. Also recommend we include a short runbook for customers describing recommended export retry/backoff behavior (example: 3 retries with exponential backoff, idempotency token). I'll draft a 1-paragraph note.

maria_cs: perfect. Action items: 
- ashley_sec to attach HSM attestation PDF + KMS rotation CSV + redacted audit trace (target: tomorrow EOD)
- jordan_eng to produce a 1-paragraph repro/remediation + gather any extra request_ids (target: today EOD)
- maria_cs to ask Kestrel for permission to share redacted logs and confirm due date extension (I'll send now)

deploy-bot: New support case created: #CS-2024-847 — sr_kestrel_sig_export. Assigned to maria_cs. ETA: 2024-06-05.

maria_cs: sent extension request to customer, they replied: "Thanks — extension accepted; please share artifacts asap. Also, can you confirm whether any key rotations occurred in May?"

ashley_sec: KMS rotation log shows no rotations in May; last rotation 2024-04-01 and next scheduled 2024-10-01. I'll include the CSV export.

jordan_eng: I've queued a short repro run against staging with a simulated slower KMS to replicate the 504 -> 401 flow. will post results in this thread when done.

maria_cs: thanks team — I'll update customer with expected artifacts and attach CS ticket link. :thumbsup:
